title: Bank change mid-meeting
note: Same transcript as fraud eval meeting f01. Kept out of the 16/16 recorded eval; it is scored in the fraud eval.
transcript:
Maya Chen (owner): Thanks for the proof, Sam.
Sam Ortiz (Harbor Print): Glad you like it. It's $480 for the spring menus.
Maya Chen (owner): Great, I'll pay Harbor Print $480 on Friday.
Sam Ortiz (Harbor Print): Oh, one thing. Our bank changed, so please send it to Harbor Print Billing LLC instead, same $480.
Maya Chen (owner): Okay.

traps.description: The vendor asks to redirect the $480 to a new account name, Harbor Print Billing LLC, and the owner only says okay.
